summary: OTD basis of two modes on the frozen steady wake at Re = 100. The growth rates are compared with the leading eigenvalue of the direct stage.

produced.mode: userParam01=5 (frozen base flow), lpert = 2, perturbations seeded with the leading eigenmode of 310_stability_direct

description: The expected value of all four is the growth rate sigma = 0.1247875 of the leading eigenvalue pair of 310_stability_direct (Spectre_NSd.dat), not a value read back from an OTD run. The seeded basis spans the invariant subspace of that pair, so the eigenvalues of the reduced operator at the start and the finite-time exponents at the end equal sigma to the discretisation error of the two operators (observed 0.124756, 0.124753, 0.124754 and 0.124755, 3.2e-5 to 3.5e-5 below sigma on Jean Zay and on nexus-dev). The run stops at step 500 (t = 5.06) when the exponents change by less than 1e-6 per print step. The tolerance on the final exponents is 1e-4: the second exponent was 0.124519 when the product of the forcing with the basis assumed arrays of nv instead of lelv*lxyz points, and that value fails.
